info.name: RideLink - Integrated Workflows
info.description: End-to-end workflows across the four RideLink microservices, including negative scenarios. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`). Tokens and ids are captured automatically, and a new runId makes every run independent.

item.name: 0. Health checks

exec: // A fresh runId per run keeps emails and plate numbers unique, so the collection can be re-run any time.
pm.test("Service is UP", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.equal("UP"); });

item.description: Run first. Start the four services (scripts/start-all) and MongoDB before running the collection.

exec: pm.test("Passenger is ACTIVE immediately", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.equal("ACTIVE"); });
pm.test("Role PASSENGER", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.equal("PASSENGER"); });
pm.test("Password hash is never returned", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("password"); });
pm.test("Driver starts PENDING (needs admin approval)", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.equal("PENDING"); });
pm.test("DRIVER token", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.equal("DRIVER"); });
pm.test("Status PENDING", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.equal("PENDING"); });

item.name: 1.4 [Negative] Pending driver cannot create a driver profile

request.description: Driver & Vehicle Service calls Account Service (GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}) and refuses because the account is PENDING.

exec: pm.test("Explains that an admin must approve", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include("approve"); });
pm.test("Standard error body", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys("timestamp", "status", "error", "message", "path"); });
pm.test("ADMIN token", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.equal("ADMIN"); });
pm.test("New driver is in the pending list", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(a => a.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("driverAccountId")));
pm.test("Driver is ACTIVE", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.equal("ACTIVE"); });
pm.test("PASSENGER token", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.equal("PASSENGER"); });
pm.test("Other fields unchanged", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.fullName).to.equal("Nadeesha Perera"); });

request.description: Interservice call: Driver & Vehicle Service verifies the account with Account Service (synchronous REST).

item.name: 2.3 [Negative] Cannot go AVAILABLE without a vehicle

exec: pm.test("Explains the rule", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include("active vehicle"); });
pm.test("Standard error body", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys("timestamp", "status", "error", "message", "path"); });
pm.test("Vehicle active", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.active).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Location stored", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.latitude).to.equal(7.2087); });

request.description: The same endpoint Ride Management Service calls during assignment.

exec: pm.test("Four vehicle types", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.rates).to.have.lengthOf(4); });
pm.test("Rule is documented", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.rule).to.include("perKm"); });

item.name: 3.2 Estimate fare Negombo Beach Road to BIA (SEDAN)

exec: pm.test("Total = base + distance + time", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalFare).to.be.closeTo(j.baseFare + j.distanceCharge + j.timeCharge, 0.01); });

request.description: Interservice call: Ride Management Service gets the estimated fare from Fare & Payment Service.

exec: pm.test("Estimated fare came from Fare service", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().estimatedFare).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("estimatedFare")));
pm.test("Passenger id taken from the token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().riderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("passengerId")));

request.description: Interservice calls: Ride Management Service asks Driver & Vehicle Service for eligible drivers, picks the nearest, and reserves them (ON_TRIP).

exec: pm.test("Invalid transition explained", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include("ASSIGNED to IN_PROGRESS"); });
pm.test("Standard error body", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys("timestamp", "status", "error", "message", "path"); });

item.name: 5.4 [Negative] Passenger cannot cancel an in-progress ride

exec: pm.test("Standard error body", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys("timestamp", "status", "error", "message", "path"); });

item.name: 5.5 Driver completes the ride (final fare calculated)

request.description: Interservice call: Fare & Payment Service calculates the final fare and opens a PENDING payment.

exec: pm.test("Final fare follows the rule (SEDAN: 200 + 120 x km + 8 x min)", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.finalFare).to.be.closeTo(200 + 120 * 9.5 + 8 * j.actualDurationMinutes, 0.01); });
pm.test("Payment opened", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.paymentId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("Every lifecycle timestamp recorded", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys('requestedAt', 'assignedAt', 'acceptedAt', 'startedAt', 'completedAt'); });

item.name: 6.1 Payment is PENDING with the final fare

exec: pm.test("Standard error body", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys("timestamp", "status", "error", "message", "path"); });
pm.test("Only last 4 digits stored", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.cardLast4).to.equal("0002"); });
pm.test("Second attempt", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.attempts).to.equal(2); });
pm.test("Double payment blocked", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include("already been paid"); });

pm.test("Receipt matches the payment", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.receiptNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("receiptNumber")); pm.expect(j.totalAmount).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("finalFare")); });
